packageRules.description: One weekly MR for every non-major update. Wintermute reviews it and posts a recommendation before a human merges.

Major versions never open an MR on their own: they wait on the dashboard issue until someone ticks them (after Wintermute's review). Database majors (postgres, mariadb, redis) need a dump/restore plan first.
Authentik off: the 2025.2.4 tag on ghcr.io is arm64-only now and we run a local amd64 copy with pull_policy: never. Upgrade by hand (planned), then turn this back on, one release at a time.
Game servers: off for now. Merging a compose change runs `docker compose up -d`, which starts a stopped server. Enable once the deploy skips stopped stacks.
